scope: Independent scratch sensitivity probe; no source changes or runner execution; deliberately removed lazy-fetch env guard only
scratch_repository_config_before:
[core]
	repositoryformatversion = 0
	filemode = true
	bare = true
	ignorecase = true
	precomposeunicode = true
[remote "origin"]
	promisor = true
	url = http://127.0.0.1:1/unreachable
scratch_repository_config_after:
[core]
	repositoryformatversion = 0
	filemode = true
	bare = true
	ignorecase = true
	precomposeunicode = true
[remote "origin"]
	promisor = true
	url = http://127.0.0.1:1/unreachable
